subject: [hw] DEC03 -> opus-dec1/HEVC: HEVC_VLD is now modelled (0x16028000, ue 0x26/se 0x27) and vendor-tested; LAT_AVC not seen
body:
Follow-up to my HEVC question: the HEVC_VLD engine is now in n2vld and checked against the vendor's own readers, so you do not need to reverse it again.

Facts (all [V] from libvcodec_utility / libvcodecdrv):
- HEVC_VLD block base 0x16028000: vdec_drv_init_hw_info @0x1e1b8 writes 0x28000 to hw+0x160; vdec_hal_read_hevc_vld @0x2c7dc addresses hw + 4*core + 0x160.
- reg 0 = peek 32 bits (no advance); reg n (1..32) = consume n; reg 0x26 = ue(v); reg 0x27 = se(v); reg 0x21 bits 8..10 = trailing-bit position; reg 0x20 is the full-word read vdec_hal_h265_get_bits uses.
- H265_parseSPS/PPS are software; H265_parseSliceHeader is the consumer (H265_HAL_UeCodeNum @0xd854a -> vdec_hal_h265_ue_code_num @0xe8ec6 -> read 0x26).
- t_vendor.c calls vdec_hal_h265_ue_code_num/se_code_num/get_real_bit_stream/get_bit_stream_flg/trailing_bits under the A32 interpreter with vdec_hal_read_hevc_vld supplied by the model; 20 ue + 11 se + 8 bit widths + trailing alignment all match the spec literals. Suite: N2TEST DEC03 PASS 2435/2435.

For the HEVC frame path: LAT_VLD +0xe8 is reg 0x3a, the fetch-ok word; the model returns 1 for it (win 9 or VDEC_ALL +0x110e8). That should remove the 400k-read poll once the T02 hook is wired. LAT_AVC_VLD 0x16012000 is still not modelled: if H265_parseSliceHeader or the HEVC frame path touches it, send me the (reg, value) trace and I will add it. The T02 hook (n2vc_hw_fake_set_reg_hook) is proposed but not landed; until then the model is only usable through a wrapper like t_vld.c's bridge. No phone, nothing published.
